spl-liver.ivc: The IVC runs posterior to the liver and receives the hepatic veins.
spl-liver.main-portal-vein: The main portal vein enters at the porta hepatis and divides into right and left branches.
spl-liver.left-hepatic-vein: The left hepatic vein drains the left liver toward the IVC.
spl-liver.middle-hepatic-vein: The middle hepatic vein follows the principal plane separating functional right and left liver.
spl-liver.right-hepatic-vein: The right hepatic vein marks the right intersegmental plane and drains to the IVC.
spl-liver.left-portal-vein: The left portal vein supplies the left liver and gives rise to segmental branches.
spl-liver.right-portal-vein: The right portal vein divides into anterior and posterior sectoral branches.
spl-liver.segment-ii: Segment II lies in the superior part of the left lateral section.
spl-liver.segment-iii: Segment III lies in the inferior part of the left lateral section.
spl-liver.segment-vi: Segment VI is in the inferior posterior right liver.
spl-liver.segment-iva: Segment IVa occupies the superior medial left liver.
spl-liver.segment-ivb: Segment IVb occupies the inferior medial left liver.
spl-liver.segment-i: Segment I is the caudate lobe, posterior to the porta hepatis and close to the IVC.
spl-liver.segment-v: Segment V is in the inferior anterior right liver.
spl-liver.segment-vii: Segment VII is in the superior posterior right liver.
spl-liver.segment-viii: Segment VIII is anterosuperior in the right liver, between the middle and right hepatic veins; its portal branches course within the segment.
spl-liver.gallbladder: The gallbladder lies along the inferior surface of the right liver near segments IVb and V.
